Genuine saves from desktop Blockbench 5.2.2 go here, named like their project (`kettle.bbmodel`):
open the committed project, change nothing, Save Project, and copy the saved file here.
`project.test.mjs` then checks that such a save still compiles to the committed models, which is
the evidence that the parser reads what the real editor writes (docs/BLOCKBENCH.md, "First session").
